command:
cat > /usr/local/bin/sync-inventory-conf.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Pulls the inventory app config from node1 (source of truth) to keep node2 in sync.
set -e
mkdir -p /etc/inventory
rsync -az -e "ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5" \
  root@node1:/etc/inventory/app.conf /etc/inventory/app.conf.tmp
if ! cmp -s /etc/inventory/app.conf.tmp /etc/inventory/app.conf 2>/dev/null; then
  mv /etc/inventory/app.conf.tmp /etc/inventory/app.conf
  logger -t sync-inventory-conf "app.conf updated from node1"
else
  rm -f /etc/inventory/app.conf.tmp
fi
EOF
chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/sync-inventory-conf.sh
mkdir -p /var/log
touch /var/log/sync-inventory-conf.log
chmod 644 /var/log/sync-inventory-conf.log
(crontab -l 2>/dev/null; echo "*/5 * * * * /usr/local/bin/sync-inventory-conf.sh >> /var/log/sync-inventory-conf.log 2>&1") | sort -u | crontab -
crontab -l
